Which word does NOT fit any blank?

Can you give me the ______ to the nearest library?
My eyes hurt because I looked at the computer ______ all day.
It takes more than a year to ______ the old building.
The burger at this restaurant is really good. I really ______ it.

questions.promptEn:
Write the words that keep the same meaning.

The number 8 represents wealth in China.
= The number 8 ______ wealth in China.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ④. originality는 타인의 작품을 베끼는 능력이 아니라, 새롭고 다른 것과 구별되는 특성이다. (답지 p.37 Vocabulary 심화 06)
questions.promptEn: Choose the definition that is NOT correct.
choices: explanation: information or details that make something clear or easy to understand
handle: the part of an object that you use to carry or hold it
originality: the ability to copy other people's work
privacy: the state of being free from other people's attention or control

choices: Sam tried to comfort me when I was sad.
The door opens automatically with a sense.
Self-driving cars will make driving easier for people.
I use an app to translate foreign texts.
Your explanation is very clear and easy to understand.

This room is used (a) ______ watching movies on weekends.
She cares (b) ______ her little brother after school.
Keep (c) ______ mind that the test is next Monday.

to put seeds or plants into the ground to grow

questions.promptEn:
In which sentence does the blank take a DIFFERENT word from the others?

① I will ______ the door for you.
② You should ______ your phone first to read the message.
③ I forgot the password, so I couldn't ______ the locker.
④ Don't forget to ______ your bike when you park it.
⑤ They will ______ the suitcase to check what is inside.
choices: I will ______ the door for you.
You should ______ your phone first to read the message.
I forgot the password, so I couldn't ______ the locker.
Don't forget to ______ your bike when you park it.
They will ______ the suitcase to check what is inside.

We came up with a new plan for the project.
Feel free to call me anytime you need help.
This bag is very similar with mine in color.
Let's take a look at the new book.
